newsitem.title: USA: Palomar unit in deal with Columbia/HCA.
newsitem.headline: Palomar unit in deal with Columbia/HCA.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said on Tuesday that its Cosmetic Technology International subsidiary agreed to develop cosmetic centers with the ambulatory surgery division of Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp.

Cosmetic Technology will provide equipment, non-recourse patient financing, operational support, service, education and training. Columbia/HCA will provide facility space, clinical personnel and administrative services.
Palomar supplies laser systems for dermatological and cosmetic treatment, including hair removal, wrinkles, spider veins, warts, scars and burns.
